messages:
Tara Morgan: Opening a 60m quiet change window for release roll-forward: terraform apply for vpc-peering + iam mapping. Need pins + rollback ladder.

Devon Price: Paste the exact module ref + provider pin so I can lock the workspace and update release notes.

Tara Morgan: Module + tfvars snippet:
```
module "vpc_peer" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-infra/modules.git//networking/vpc_peering?ref=release/2026-03-22-2f7e"
}

// terraform.tfvars.json
{
  "peer_vpc_id": "vpc-09abc123def",
  "apply_role_arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-network-apply"
}
```

Tara Morgan: Provider pin: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 5.0" } }`

Deploybot: Preflight: terraform plan queued in 5m. If plan reports deletes to shared subnets or >2 destructive actions, run will pause.

Ravi Shah: I'll run a single-AZ canary then stagger the rest. I'll monitor route propagation and NAT metrics.

Devon Price: Rollback ladder (short):
1) Halt remaining applies.
2) Revert module ref to `release/2026-03-15-stable` and run `terraform apply -var-file=revert.tfvars.json`.
3) If cross-account connectivity impacted, fail traffic to fallback TGW and escalate to SRE.

ops-bot: @channel Please create a release-tracker entry and attach plan output and run ids.

Tara Morgan: Preflight result: plan OK (no deletions). Canary job jt-12133 scheduled in 8m.

Ravi Shah: Canary apply started (jt-12133). Posting plan snippet and will stream logs here.

(4m later)
Ravi Shah: Canary apply succeeded. smoke tests all green (curl health, traceroute checks). logs: https://ci.internal/reports/jt-12133

Tara Morgan: Locking tfvars and tagging infra commit to release/2026-03-22-2f7e. Scheduling prod apply in 20m.

Deploybot: Prod apply queued jt-12134, owner=Ravi Shah, automated rollback watch ON.

Devon Price: I'll watch 5m buckets for 502/504 spikes >1.5% and route-flap alerts. Trigger rollback if thresholds met.

(After prod)
Deploybot: Prod apply finished: success. run_id=jt-12134. No destructive changes.

Tara Morgan: Updated release notes with module commit, provider pin, run ids, and rollback steps. Will remove canary flag after QA signoff. Closing quiet window in 30m. :lock:
